root_cause.text: The bonding driver’s `bond_header_parse()` used `skb->dev` to identify the device during recursive header parsing, so in a stacked bonding setup it kept seeing the top-level bond device and could recurse indefinitely instead of reaching the leaf device’s parse method.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message says `bond_header_parse() can loop if a stack of two bonding devices is setup, because skb->dev always points to the hierarchy top`, and the patch fixes this by changing `struct header_ops->parse()` to take an explicit `const struct net_device *dev` and by making `bond_header_parse()` recurse with `slave->dev` rather than `skb->dev`.

candidates.rationale: This uses skb->dev to identify the device during bond header parsing. In stacked bonding, skb->dev can remain the top-level bond device instead of the intended slave, causing recursive parsing to re-enter the bond parser instead of reaching the leaf device.

This condition gates the recursive call into the lower device's parse method. Because the surrounding logic selects the lower device based on skb->dev-derived bond context, the callback can keep dispatching back into bonding rather than the real leaf parser.
This is the recursive header parsing call that should use the provided slave net_device context. With the wrong device context from skb->dev, it can recurse indefinitely in stacked bonding setups.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement identifies the bonding device from skb->dev during header parsing. In a stacked bonding configuration, skb->dev can still point to the upper bond device, so recursive parsing does not advance to the lower/slave device and can recurse indefinitely.

This condition controls whether parsing is delegated to the lower device's header_ops->parse callback. Because the surrounding logic derives the lower-device context from skb->dev, this delegation can repeatedly re-enter bonding instead of reaching the leaf parser.

This recursive parse call is the direct mechanism by which the bug manifests. With the wrong device context coming from skb->dev, the callback can dispatch back into bonding repeatedly and recurse indefinitely in stacked bonding setups.
